aboutMe: I’m a Senior Software Developer with 4 years of total experience building full-stack applications, REST APIs, and AI-powered workflows. My core stack is Ruby on Rails, React, Next.js, and PostgreSQL. At Shriffle Technologies, I work on production features, integrations, database performance, and automated testing across healthcare, CRM, and music products. My work includes Gmail webhooks, Salesforce OAuth, ACR Cloud, and AI-assisted document extraction with OpenAI and AWS Bedrock. I’m also building OrbitFlow for lead and client workflow automation and Aone Mart, a React Native Android app and backend. I’m interested in senior, backend, and full-stack engineering opportunities where I can build reliable products and solve meaningful business problems.
